metadata.name: Damage MVP
metadata.description:
Shows what dealt the damage: an on-screen breakdown of your damage to enemies in the current room, ranked by source — tears, lasers named by weapon, melee, bombs, each familiar by name, blasts from exploding shots, and the creep, gas and fire they leave behind.
Burn and poison ticks go to whatever applied the status, not to whatever hit last. Resets each room. Damage enemies deal to each other is never credited to you.
